name: An Indoor Camembert Picnic Platter For Parties And Ftes
instructions: Inside: arrange the cheese , saucisson , tomatoes , radishes , fruit and accompaniments on plates , wooden boards or platters
Or , arrange them in picnic or sandwich boxes in a wicker hamper ! cut the bread and set out the butter
Have plates , napkins and cutlery at the ready
Serve with a bottle of dry southern french ros or a glass of sparkling normandy cider
Outside: pack up the camembert , saucisson , radishes , tomatoes , cherries and wine in a cool bag
Put the baguette in a separate bag
Dont forget plates , glasses , napkins a couple of sharp knives and a corkscrew
Slice the sausage and cut the camembert into wedges
Tear off a hunk of baguette and eat with the cheese , fruit , vegetables and all the other accompaniments !
